On May 3, the team focused on stabilizing the agent runtime and cloud infrastructure by resolving critical headless Linux segfaults, Telegram polling race conditions, and authentication flow issues. Significant progress was also made in refining the Automations UX and streamlining repository maintenance to improve CI/CD reliability.

✅ Completed Work

Runtime Stability & Authentication Fixes

  • Resolved a process-level segfault on headless Linux by implementing a fallback for @napi-rs/keyring (elizaos/eliza#7231, elizaos-plugins/plugin-n8n-workflow#7231).
  • Fixed Telegram bot token bridging and eliminated race conditions caused by multiple concurrent Telegraf pollers (elizaos/eliza#7240, elizaos/eliza#7245, elizaos-plugins/plugin-n8n-workflow#7240, elizaos-plugins/plugin-n8n-workflow#7245).
  • Updated hasCodexCliSubscriptionAuth to support modern token shapes, ensuring correct routing on fresh installs (elizaos/eliza#7238, elizaos/eliza#7243, elizaos-plugins/plugin-n8n-workflow#7238, elizaos-plugins/plugin-n8n-workflow#7243).
  • Fixed duplicate MiladyClient class definitions to ensure proper domain method augmentation (elizaos/eliza#7233, elizaos/eliza#7244, elizaos-plugins/plugin-n8n-workflow#7233, elizaos-plugins/plugin-n8n-workflow#7244).

Automations & UX Enhancements

  • Restored the NL-first hero centerpiece for Automations and implemented inline workflow creation fixes (elizaos/eliza#7317).
  • Completed the n8n clarification roundtrip to ensure hosts correctly render clarification requests (elizaos/eliza#7316).
  • Introduced the ConnectorTargetCatalog service to surface Discord guilds and channels for n8n integration (elizaos/eliza#7315).

Infrastructure & Dependency Maintenance

  • Streamlined CI/CD by removing legacy Rust/Python components and updating core dependencies like React 19.2.5 and Python 3.14 (elizaos/eliza#7235, elizaos/eliza#7331, elizaos/eliza#7322, elizaos/eliza#7280).
  • Resolved SIWE authentication and cloud test errors to unblock CI pipelines (elizaos/eliza#7333, elizaos/eliza#7332, elizaos/eliza#7327, elizaos/eliza#7324).
